review:
Gold Of Minos is a 5x3, 243-ways slot where the Minotaur is an expanded wild that covers his whole reel when he lands. If he doesn't form a win, he triggers a respin bonus instead.

The respins continue until a winning combination lands, and every empty respin increases the multiplier, up to 1,024x, so a long run of misses builds towards one big multiplied win. Three versions of the bonus buy let you start the respins directly where permitted. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 15,360x maximum and a 96% RTP. It uses the same respin idea as Golden Pride, reworked with a Greek-myth theme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
